name: khobz-index
description: Karama Khobz Index — weekly pipeline and static archive tooling

scripts.pipeline: bun run pipeline:prefetch && FAOSTAT_CP_JSON_PATH=data/reference/faostat-pp-backfill.json bun run src/pipeline/run.ts
scripts.pipeline:backfill: bun run pipeline:prefetch && bun run pipeline:prefetch-cpi && PIPELINE_SKIP_R2_MIRROR=1 FAOSTAT_CP_JSON_PATH=data/reference/faostat-pp-backfill.json HISTORICAL_CPI_JSON_PATH=data/reference/historical-cpi-envelope.json bun run src/pipeline/run.ts --backfill --from=1990-01
scripts.pipeline:backfill:tail: bun run pipeline:prefetch && PIPELINE_SKIP_R2_MIRROR=1 FAOSTAT_CP_JSON_PATH=data/reference/faostat-pp-backfill.json HISTORICAL_CPI_JSON_PATH=data/reference/historical-cpi-envelope.json bun run src/pipeline/run.ts --backfill
scripts.pages:build: bun run pages:shard && cd landing && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.pages:deploy: wrangler pages project create khobz-index-landing --production-branch main 2>/dev/null; cd landing && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name khobz-index-landing
